decisive_items: a recurrent skin lesion on the dorsum of his right thumb
an enlarged ipsilateral axillary lymph node presumed to represent metastatic disease
a 1.8 × 1.3 cm well-circumscribed, firm, non-tender, indurated lesion
response.rationale: Recurrent skin lesion with regional lymph node metastasis strongly favors malignant melanoma; R3 provides the specific label and supporting spans, while R5 is a less specific synonym.

rejected.why: Merkel cell carcinoma is less likely given thumb location and recurrence pattern; no specific support.
Squamous cell carcinoma can metastasize but the lesion description and recurrence are more typical of melanoma.
Misspelled and lacks specific support; Merkel cell carcinoma is not the best fit.
